PARVATI VINOD CHOURASIYA 
Securities Operations & Reference Data Analyst | Investment Banking Operations 
Pune, India | +91 8762008630 | Immediate Joiner| parvativc1999@gmail.com 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Detail-oriented Securities Operations professional with 5+ years of experience in securities pricing, valuation, and 
reference data management within investment banking operations. Skilled in resolving pricing exceptions, processing 
corporate actions, and performing multi-vendor data reconciliation across Bloomberg, IDC, IHS Markit, DTCC, Euroclear, 
Clearstream, and SIX. Demonstrated ability to support NAV accuracy, ensure regulatory compliance, and collaborate 
cross-functionally with clients, brokers, investment managers, and fund accounting teams. Immediate joiner seeking to 
apply strong analytical and reconciliation expertise to a securities operations or reference data role. 
 
CORE COMPETENCIES 
Securities Pricing & Valuation | Reference Data Management | Corporate Actions Processing | Multi-Vendor Data 
Reconciliation | NAV Support | Exception & Tolerance-Failure Resolution | Regulatory Compliance | Checker/Maker 
Controls | Fund Accounting Support | Client & Stakeholder Management 
 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Analyst – Securities Master File & Reference Data June 2024 – June 2026 
Hexaware Technologies, Pune, India 
● Managed the end-to-end Securities Master File (SMF) reference data lifecycle for equities, bonds, mutual funds, 
and derivatives, including futures, options, currency options, and repos. 
● Created and maintained security setups across Bloomberg, IHS Markit, IDC, DTCC, SIX, Euroclear, and 
Clearstream. 
● Executed multi-vendor data reconciliation across Bloomberg, IDC, DTCC, Clearstream, SIX, WSO, and Euroclear to 
ensure consistent, accurate reference data. 
● Monitored real-time market data feeds via Bloomberg Terminal and other vendor platforms, evaluating the 
impact of corporate actions and security identifier changes on multi-CSD reconciliation. 
● Performed checker/maker controls on security setup records and reviewed legal documentation to ensure 
compliance with regulatory standards. 
Financial Analyst – Securities Pricing & Valuation December 2020 – August 2023 
State Street HCL Services, Pune, India 
● Priced financial instruments — equities, bonds, derivatives, and mutual funds — in accordance with Price Source 
Agreements (PSA) using data from Reuters, Bloomberg, and IDC. 
● Resolved pricing exceptions including no-price, halted, stale, suspect, and expired price scenarios. 
● Investigated exceptional pricing scenarios by liaising with data vendors, including Bloomberg, JPMorgan, IDC, and 
Markit, to resolve discrepancies. 
● Worked closely with clients, brokers, investment managers, and accounting teams to resolve securities valuation 
issues and their impact on NAV. 
● Researched tolerance-failure securities caused by price movements and corporate actions, coordinating with the 
Reference Data team to automate and link identifiers. 
● Handled various corporate actions such as bonus issues, spin-offs, rights issues, mergers, splits, reverse splits, and 
dividends. 
● Supported Fund Accounting in calculating Net Asset Value (NAV) by pricing client portfolio holdings.
